assertions.subject: Immune Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: autoimmune disorder is characterized by antiplatelet IgG antibodies

assertions.subject: Immune Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: In pregnancy, these antibodies may cross the placenta and cause fetal thrombocytopenia

assertions.subject: Neonatal platelet levels
assertions.predicate: nadir at 48 to 72 hours of life
assertions.quote: neonatal platelet levels may fall rapidly after birth, with a nadir at 48 to 72 hours of life

assertions.subject: Maternal ITP
assertions.quote: Neither the maternal platelet count, identification of anti platelet antibodies, nor treatment with corticosteroids efectively predicts fetal or neonatal platelet counts

assertions.subject: Fetal thrombocytopenia
assertions.predicate: adequate platelet counts for vaginal delivery
assertions.quote: fetal platelet counts are usually adequate to allow vaginal delivery without an increased risk of ICH
